items.title: Authorize protected job status GET
items.context: authority_job_status/listJobVerdicts should include the resolved customer API key for protected server reads while policy discovery remains unauthenticated.
items.userSees: `authority_job_status` sends `Authorization: Bearer <customer-key>` on protected `/v1/jobs/<jobId>/verdicts` reads, while `/v1/authority/policy` remains keyless.

happy.desc: server-backed job status/verdict GET carries Authorization when a customer API key is configured

edge.desc: policy discovery GET still carries no Authorization header

adversarial.desc: successful protected read without receipt/quorum still leaves fullAuthorityDone false

items.title: Add smoke coverage for the regression
items.context: The smoke should prove verdict GET carries Authorization and policy discovery GET does not.
